description: DeepSeek content source registry. Discovered via robots.txt/sitemap/llms.txt probing.

api-docs.deepseek.com.notes: API docs, Docusaurus SSR. No llms.txt and no .md variants (unknown paths fall through to the SPA shell with HTTP 200) -- pages are mirrored by converting the server-rendered HTML article body to markdown. Sitemap per locale: /sitemap.xml (en), /zh-cn/sitemap.xml (zh-cn), 63 pages each.

www.deepseek.com.notes: Product landing; not part of this mirror

github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness.notes: dsh (DeepSeek Harness) repo -- README + docs/ tree, the only home of the dsh docs. Developer preview, breaking changes promised; mirrored by scripts/dsh.py via the git trees API + raw.githubusercontent.com, pinned to the default branch.

registry.npmjs.org.notes: @deepseek-ai/dsh packument; publishes no readme (as of 0.1.0-rc.6), so the mirror renders dist-tags + version history instead.

sources.name: api-docs-en
sources.notes: English docs: quick start, API reference (OpenAI + Anthropic + Responses formats), guides, samples, agent integrations, news

sources.name: api-docs-zh-cn
sources.notes: Chinese mirror of the same pages, identical path layout

sources.name: dsh-github
sources.notes: dsh repo README (-> dsh/index.md) + English docs/ tree; .zh.md and .i18n.yaml sidecars skipped. Fetched by scripts/dsh.py; deletions are pruned because upstream deletes without migration (.dsh-plugin manifest, 2026-08-09).

sources.name: dsh-npm
sources.notes: Package metadata page: dist-tags, latest, version history. No readme published upstream yet; picked up verbatim if one appears.
